Low-level ambient outdoor noise is present but does not interfere with vocal clarity. (2) The narration continues with a slight increase in assertiveness as he details contradictions in the emails. The BGM remains consistent in volume and tempo. A very subtle fabric rustle occurs as the speaker gestures. As the speech ends, the BGM continues for a few seconds before fading out smoothly under a black screen.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to warn travelers about a specific third-party booking platform (iWofly) by analyzing contradictory emails received after a failed flight booking. The creator uses his personal experience to illustrate red flags such as inconsistent explanations and the use of unknown credit cards, ultimately advising viewers to book through official or reputable channels.
